# IPTVMac 0.25.35 — Apple Silicon, unnotarized
This is the owner's explicitly approved **unnotarized, Apple Development-signed** release. It is not Developer ID-signed and has not been notarized by Apple. macOS may warn or block it. Download/hash/signature verification does not promise first-launch acceptance, and no security protection is disabled by the helper.
## Download
- Apple Silicon (arm64), macOS 14 or newer. No Intel/Universal binary is provided. - Download `IPTVMac-macos-arm64.zip`, or use the repository's reviewed terminal helper with `--repo Musabaxmedov94/IPTVMac --download-only`. - The helper downloads and verifies the ZIP; it never installs, replaces or launches an application. Install manually with Finder after quitting an older IPTVMac normally. Account workspaces and playlists are outside the app bundle.
## Included
- Account-separated local libraries and provider credentials. - Provider-neutral M3U and Xtream connections; each user supplies their own. - Shared TMDB metadata routing and explicit signed in-app update support. - A rebuilt dynamically linked LGPL media runtime, with OpenGL rendering, subtitles and native macOS audio support.
No personal provider links, passwords, playlist/catalogue databases, viewing history or Keychain exports are included. Firebase client configuration and public service/update URLs are part of the app; server credentials are not.
## Third-party runtime source and notices
`IPTVMac-Runtime-Sources.zip` contains the exact runtime source archives, checksums, build recipes and license/copyright notices. The app also contains third-party notices. Application source is maintained separately in a private repository; this asset is the source of the redistributable media libraries, not the owner's private application or user data.
The update feed and application archive are signed with the owner's separate Sparkle update key. Apple notarization is a different process and is not claimed by those signatures. A real separate-Mac launch and version-to-version update acceptance check remains the recipient's test, not a result established by this download.
